standard_desc: Simplified interface focused on writing, editing, and AI assistance
developer_desc: Full development environment with git worktrees, terminal access, development-specific features
referral_question: How did you hear about Nimbalyst?
email_help: Receive occasional product updates and tips
disclaimer: We collect usage data to improve Nimbalyst. No prompts or content is ever collected. You can opt out of analytics any time in Settings.
continue_agree: By continuing, you agree to our
ai_detail_placeholder: What model and prompt did you use?
invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address
worktree_description: Worktrees create a git branch in an isolated directory, separate from your main repository. This gives you a safe place to make changes without affecting the rest of your code.
safe_experiment_desc: AI changes stay in a separate branch
easy_review_desc: Review and merge changes when ready
open_markdown: Open Markdown files from the sidebar
edit_files: Edit files directly or use the agent on the right side
auto_save: Files are automatically saved as you work

welcome_modal.welcome_body: Nimbalyst is a powerful editor with integrated planning, tracking, and AI features. This quick setup will help you get started.

features.planning_desc: Organize features, bugs, and tasks with structured markdown plans
features.ai_desc: Work with Claude Agent and other AI assistants for enhanced productivity
features.progress_desc: Visual plan view to monitor status and progress across all work items

plans.description: Where would you like to store your plan documents?
plans.private_desc: Private plans not checked into version control. Best for personal planning.
plans.shared_desc: Shared plans checked into version control. Best for team collaboration.
plans.created: Plans directory will be created at the specified location
plans.gitignore_note: The directory will be added to .gitignore (not checked in)
plans.in_repo: Plans will be included in your repository (team collaboration)

claude.description: Configure Claude Agent to understand Nimbalyst's extended markdown features for plans and tracking.
claude.project_desc: Commands stored in project directory, can be checked into version control for team sharing
claude.global_desc: Commands stored in home directory, shared across all projects
claude.enable_later: You can enable Claude Agent integration later from project settings.

first_plan.description: Let's create your first plan document to get familiar with the system.
first_plan.example_desc: Start with a pre-filled example that shows the plan structure
first_plan.storage: Plans are stored in the {{path}} directory as markdown files with frontmatter metadata.

plan_view.description: The plan view helps you track all your plans, their status, and progress.
plan_view.status_desc: See all plans grouped by status (draft, in-progress, completed, etc.)
plan_view.filter_desc: Filter by type, priority, or tags. Sort by date, progress, or priority.
plan_view.progress_desc: Visual progress bars show completion percentage for each plan
plan_view.sidebar: Click the plans icon in the sidebar

complete.title: You're all set!
complete.body: Your workspace is configured and ready to use.
complete.new_plan: Create your first real plan with File → New Plan
complete.view: Check out the plan view to see all your plans
complete.tracking: Start organizing your work with the tracking system
complete.help_body: Access documentation from the Help menu or visit the Nimbalyst website.

extension_intro.title: Build with Extensions
extension_intro.description: Extensions add custom editors, AI tools, commands, panels, and more. Nimbalyst loads your extension live while you develop.
extension_intro.editors: Custom editors for any file type, with native look and feel
extension_intro.panels: Side panels and workspace views for dashboards and live status
extension_intro.ai_tools: AI tools that Claude can use while working in your project
extension_intro.dev_loop: In-app dev loop — build, install, and reload without leaving Nimbalyst
extension_intro.agent_help: Describe what you want to the agent, and it will scaffold, build, and install the extension for you.
